name: umbrella
description: Deprecated: use the WP Umbrella MCP server instead (https://mcp.wp-umbrella.com/). This plugin is no longer maintained and no longer tracks the WP Umbrella Public API. It operated your WordPress sites through Claude by calling the Public API with curl.

token.title: WP Umbrella API Token
token.description: Your WP Umbrella Public API token. Generate one in your dashboard under Profile → Public API (for developers). This is NOT the dashboard↔plugin connection key.
